name: Cammycakes Gaming
noteEs: Creator de Destiny 2 con tono editorial relajado y curiosidad sobre buildcrafting experimental. En lugar de tier lists o coverage de news, sus videos exploran ideas — '¿este weapon es secretamente bueno?', '¿esta synergy funciona?', '¿qué pasa si combinamos estas dos cosas raras?'. Para jugadores que ya pasaron de las builds meta y quieren ver experimentos honestos, Cammycakes ofrece esa perspectiva.
noteEn: Destiny 2 creator with a relaxed editorial tone and curiosity about experimental buildcrafting. Rather than tier lists or news coverage, his videos explore ideas — 'is this weapon secretly good?', 'does this synergy work?', 'what happens if we combine these two weird things?'. For players past meta builds who want honest experiments, Cammycakes offers that perspective.
highlightsEs: Spotlights de armas underrated con tests in-game
Experimentos de buildcrafting con synergies inusuales
Análisis editorial relajado de patches y meta shifts
Cobertura honesta sobre qué funciona y qué no en endgame real
highlightsEn: Spotlights on underrated weapons with in-game tests
Relaxed editorial analysis of patches and meta shifts
Honest coverage of what works and doesn't in real endgame
